import itertools, subprocess, os, sys, time
chars=[' ','-','*','+','1','.',':','>','`','~','a','\n']
start=time.time(); count=0
for n in range(1,7):
  for tup in itertools.product(chars, repeat=n):
    s=''.join(tup).encode()
    open('/tmp/cand','wb').write(s)
    r=subprocess.run(['/workspace/hoedown_trace','/tmp/cand'], stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=1)
    count+=1
    if b'OOBPATH' in r.stderr:
      print('FOUND',repr(s))
      print(r.stderr.decode(errors='ignore'))
      raise SystemExit
print('none', count, 'time', time.time()-start)
